name: Local LLM
label: Local LLM
description: Self-hosted OpenAI-compatible LLM provider for the v2 agent model-port contract (INPUT llm_input → OUTPUT llm_output). The handler reads llm_input, merges instance configurationParameters, strips a designer picker env prefix from model, and calls studioquack.llm.completion() — the StudioQuack engine daemon proxies that call to the OpenAI-compatible engine configured in Engine Settings (Ollama, vLLM, llama.cpp, TGI, or any BYO /v1/chat/completions endpoint). Provider base URL, API keys, and TLS material never enter this sandbox; only the bare model id, sampling knobs, tools, and messages are forwarded. When stream is true (default), the handler emits live helper emitPartial("thinking", delta) for reasoning/thinking token deltas and emitPartial("answer", delta) for content deltas, then returns one aggregated llm_output.result (thoughts/thinking, finish_reason, usage, tool_calls assembled at end). On any exception the node still HTTP-200s with llm_output.result = {error, type}. Do not use this node for OpenAI cloud keys — use OpenAI Models. templateId: 1c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b123. Purpose: the handler reads this field to drive Local LLM. Example: "sample". Model select stores envId::modelId; the handler strips the prefix and sets envId on the daemon LLM call so credentials never enter this sandbox. On exception llm_output.result is {error, type}. Data protection: prompts and context stay on the daemon's local LLM provider proxy (Engine Settings); they do not go to OpenAI cloud. GDPR: processing remains under the operator's host. Secrets never enter this sandbox.
author: c525bb64-f52e-4829-8bf0-f1fe33aa6b42

ports.name: llm_input
ports.description: Canonical v2 LLM request. The handler reads studioquack.getInputValuesByPortValue('llm_input') (first list element). A bare UTF-8 string is wrapped as {messages:[{role:'user', content:<string>}]}. A JSON string is json.loads'd. Object keys messages, prompt, tools are consumed; any other top-level key that is not already a configurationParameter shortCode is forwarded verbatim to studioquack.llm.completion() (OpenAI-compatible passthrough). REQUIRED: empty/missing input fails with result {error, type:'ValueError'} and message 'No input received on llm_input'. Either messages or prompt should be present (both omitted → daemon/provider error). Streaming is governed by this node's own stream/streaming configuration (default ON), never per call. Example: {"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize this log."}],"tools":[]}. Purpose: the handler reads this field to drive llm_input. Accepted: type INPUT; required.

schema.label: messages
schema.description: Chat-completions message list passed to studioquack.llm.completion(messages=…). Purpose: the conversation the local engine must complete. Accepted value: JSON array of objects {role, content, tool_calls?, thinking?, thoughts?, tool_call_id?, name?}. role is one of system | user | assistant | tool (case-sensitive, OpenAI-compatible). content is a string or a list of typed blocks: {type:'text', text} | {type:'image'|'audio'|'video'|'document', mime_type, source:'base64'|'url'|'file_id', data, name?} | {type:'tool_use', id, name, input} | {type:'tool_result', tool_use_id, content}. Omit or [] when using prompt instead. Invalid non-array/non-object is forwarded as-is and typically 400s at the engine. Example: [{"role":"system","content":"You are a log analyst."},{"role":"user","content":"What failed in build 442?"}].

schema.label: tools
schema.description: Function-calling tool definitions merged into the completion call as tools=… unless already supplied via configuration. Purpose: advertise callable tools to the local engine. Accepted value: list of {name:string, description:string, request:<JSON Schema object>}. name must be a non-empty identifier the model can emit. Omit, null, or [] → no tools field on the daemon call. Invalid non-list is still assigned and may 400 at the engine. Example: [{"name":"lookup_order","description":"Fetch an order by id.","request":{"type":"object","properties":{"order_id":{"type":"string"}},"required":["order_id"]}}].

schema.label: inputFiles
schema.description: User-uploaded files and voice clips for the model. Folded onto the last user message (or a new user message) then converted under the BASIC OpenAI-compatible profile (text / image_url only).

children.label: kind
children.description: File kind. EXACT values: image | document | audio | video.

children.label: mime_type
children.description: RFC 1521 media type, e.g. application/pdf, image/png.

children.label: source
children.description: How the payload is carried. EXACT values: base64 | url. Default: base64.

children.label: data
children.description: Base64-encoded payload (when source=base64) or absolute URL (when source=url).

children.label: name
children.description: Original filename, surfaced as the upload name.

ports.name: llm_output
ports.description: Always emitted via studioquack.returnResult([ResultItem('llm_output', {result: …, outputFiles?})]). Success: result is the assistant payload extracted from the provider's first choice (choices[0].message, or {role:'assistant', content: choices[0].text} for legacy text completions), plus thoughts/thinking (reasoning deltas accumulated during stream), output_files when the engine returns media, finish_reason, usage, and tool_calls assembled after the stream ends. Non-empty result.output_files / outputFiles are also copied to top-level outputFiles on this envelope. The port is still present on HTTP 200; do not treat HTTP status as success. Example success envelope: {"result":{"role":"assistant","content":"4","finish_reason":"stop"}}. Purpose: the handler reads this field to drive llm_output. Accepted: type OUTPUT; omit to use default "llm_output". Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: result
schema.description: Success assistant payload (fields depend on the local engine, all optional except role/content on a normal chat turn): {role:'assistant', content: string | [{type:'text', text}], tool_calls?:[{id, name, args, type:'tool_call'}], thoughts?:[{type:'thinking'|'reasoning_summary', text, signature?}], thinking?: <legacy mirror of thoughts, [{type:'thinking', thinking:string}]>, output_files?:[{type, mime_type, source, data, name?}], finish_reason?: 'stop'|'length'|'tool_calls'|'content_filter'|'error'|engine-specific, usage?:{prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, reasoning_tokens?}}. During streaming, thinking/reasoning deltas are also published live via helper emitPartial("thinking", delta) and content deltas via emitPartial("answer", delta); the fields above are the assembled end state. ValueError, TimeoutError, HelperException). Never contains daemon credentials or the envId prefix. Example success: {"role":"assistant","content":"The build failed at test CollectOrder.","thoughts":[{"type":"thinking","text":"Checking the stack trace…"}],"thinking":[{"type":"thinking","thinking":"Checking the stack trace…"}],"finish_reason":"stop","usage":{"prompt_tokens":128,"completion_tokens":42,"total_tokens":170}}. Example error: {"error":"Connection refused to local engine","type":"ConnectionError"}. Purpose: the handler reads this field to drive result. Accepted: type object; required.

children.label: role
children.description: Always 'assistant' on a completed turn.

children.label: content
children.description: Typed content blocks: {type:'text', text} plus media/tool blocks. The final answer text is the concatenation of text blocks.

children.label: tool_calls
children.description: Tool calls the model requested: {id, name, arguments}. Present only when the model calls tools.

children.label: thoughts
children.description: Reasoning trace entries {text} when the model exposes chain-of-thought.

children.label: thinking
children.description: Thinking blocks {type:'thinking', thinking} mirroring thoughts for UI rendering.

children.label: output_files
children.description: Generated files {kind, mime_type, source, data, name} (e.g. audio out).

children.label: kind
children.description: File kind. EXACT values: image | document | audio | video.

children.label: mime_type
children.description: RFC 1521 media type, e.g. application/pdf, image/png.

children.label: source
children.description: How the payload is carried. EXACT values: base64 | url. Default: base64.

children.label: data
children.description: Base64-encoded payload (when source=base64) or absolute URL (when source=url).

children.label: name
children.description: Original filename, surfaced as the upload name.

children.label: finish_reason
children.description: Provider finish reason (stop, tool_calls, length, ...).

children.label: usage
children.description: Token usage {prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, reasoning_tokens?} when the provider reports it.

schema.description: Files produced by the model, e.g. generated images/audio. Copied from result.output_files / result.outputFiles when non-empty; omitted when empty.

schema.label: streaming
schema.description: Live stream channel, present when the request sets stream/streaming true. While `result` assembles, the node emits deltas as {channel, delta} frames: channel 'thinking' carries reasoning/thinking deltas, channel 'answer' carries content deltas. A function-port caller (e.g. AI Agent model port) listens to this channel to render the stream live; the final assembled payload always arrives in `result`.

children.label: channel
children.description: Delta channel. EXACT values: thinking | answer.

children.label: delta
children.description: Incremental text piece for the channel. Append in arrival order.

configurationParameters.label: AI Model
configurationParameters.description: Model identifier on the daemon's configured OpenAI-compatible provider. Purpose: studioquack.llm.completion(model=…) after stripping the designer picker prefix. The designer populates options via GET /be/v1/llm/models/picker (labels like 'llama3.1 (Mac Mini LLM)'; stored value 'envId::modelId'). The handler splits on the first '::': left side is target_env (daemon overlay routing; the running engine must hold an llm allow-list rule on that engine); right side is the bare model id sent to the provider. No '::' → loopback on this engine (target_env=null). Required (required:true). Empty/missing → completion is called without a model and the daemon/provider returns an error that is packed as {error, type}. Do not put credentials here. Example stored value: '3f2a9c10-1111-2222-3333-444455556666::llama3.1'. Example loopback: 'llama3.1'. Accepted: type select; required.

configurationParameters.label: Temperature
configurationParameters.description: Sampling temperature forwarded as a float to the local provider. Purpose: controls randomness of token sampling. Accepted values: number or numeric string in 0.0–2.0 (OpenAI-compatible). Parsed with float(); non-numeric is omitted so the engine default applies. Empty string / unset → omitted from the request. Example: 0.2 for extraction; 0.8 for drafting.

configurationParameters.label: Top P
configurationParameters.description: Nucleus sampling top_p forwarded as a float. Purpose: restrict sampling to the smallest set of tokens whose cumulative probability ≥ top_p. Accepted values: number or numeric string in 0.0–1.0. Non-numeric or empty → omitted. Example: 0.9. Do not combine aggressive temperature and top_p unless the engine documents that pairing.

configurationParameters.label: Max Completion Tokens
configurationParameters.description: Hard cap on completion tokens (max_completion_tokens). Purpose: bound cost and latency of one call. Preferred over deprecated max_tokens. Accepted values: positive integers (parsed int(); floats that are whole numbers are accepted). Empty/unset → omitted. Invalid non-numeric → omitted. When both this and max_tokens are set, this wins. Example: 1024.

configurationParameters.label: Max Tokens (deprecated)
configurationParameters.description: Deprecated OpenAI alias for output length. Purpose: forwarded as max_tokens only when set AND max_completion_tokens is unset. Accepted values: positive integers. Empty → omitted. Prefer max_completion_tokens. Example: 512.

configurationParameters.label: Frequency Penalty
configurationParameters.description: OpenAI-compatible frequency penalty forwarded as float. Purpose: penalize tokens already present in the text proportionally to count. Accepted values: -2.0–2.0. Empty/non-numeric → omitted. Support depends on the local engine (Ollama may ignore it). Example: 0.2.

configurationParameters.label: Presence Penalty
configurationParameters.description: OpenAI-compatible presence penalty forwarded as float. Purpose: penalize tokens once they have appeared, encouraging new topics. Accepted values: -2.0–2.0. Empty/non-numeric → omitted. Example: 0.1.

configurationParameters.label: Stop Sequences
configurationParameters.description: Stop sequences forwarded to the provider. Purpose: halt generation when a sequence is emitted. Accepted values: a JSON array of strings, or a raw string (parsed as JSON when possible, otherwise kept as a single stop string). OpenAI-compatible engines typically allow at most 4 sequences. Empty → omitted. Example JSON: ["END","\n\nUser:"]. Example raw: 'END'.

configurationParameters.label: Completions Count
configurationParameters.description: Number of completions to generate (n). Purpose: request multiple samples. Accepted values: positive integers. Empty → omitted (provider default, usually 1). The handler still returns only choices[0] on llm_output. Example: 1.

configurationParameters.label: Logprobs
configurationParameters.description: Whether to return token log-probabilities. Purpose: forwarded as a real boolean (not the string 'true') because strict OpenAI-compatible servers 400 on stringly-typed scalars. Accepted values: boolean, or strings true|1|yes|on / false|0|no|off (case-insensitive). Unparseable → omitted. Default stored value 'false'. Support depends on the local engine. Example: false.

configurationParameters.label: Top Logprobs
configurationParameters.description: Number of most likely tokens to return at each position when logprobs=true. Purpose: forwarded as integer top_logprobs. Accepted values: non-negative integers (typical OpenAI range 0–20). Empty → omitted. Ignored by engines that do not support logprobs. Example: 5.

configurationParameters.label: Reasoning Effort
configurationParameters.description: Reasoning-model hint forwarded when the local engine supports it (o-series / some gpt-5* compatible endpoints). Purpose: trade latency vs. hidden reasoning tokens. EXACT accepted values: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high'. Empty / unset → omitted. Unknown strings are still forwarded and may 400 at the engine. Example: 'medium'.

configurationParameters.label: Verbosity
configurationParameters.description: Reasoning verbosity hint for compatible models. Purpose: how much of the reasoning the engine should surface. Accepted values: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high'. Empty → omitted. Example: 'low'.

configurationParameters.label: Response Format
configurationParameters.description: Structured-output hint parsed as JSON when possible. Purpose: ask the engine for JSON or a schema-constrained object. Accepted values: JSON object string such as {"type":"json_object"}; literals 'json' or 'text' (engine-dependent); or a JSON-schema object string. Empty → omitted. Invalid JSON that is not json/text is omitted (not forwarded raw) unless the parser keeps a dict/list. Example: {"type":"json_object"}.

configurationParameters.label: Output Modalities
configurationParameters.description: Requested output modalities for multimodal chat models. Purpose: forwarded as modalities to engines that can return audio as well as text. Accepted values: JSON array or comma-separated list. Typical tokens: 'text', 'audio'. Empty → omitted. Example: ["text"] or ["text","audio"].

configurationParameters.label: Audio Output Config
configurationParameters.description: JSON object for audio output settings when modalities includes audio. Purpose: voice and container format for local engines that speak. Accepted value: JSON object, e.g. {"voice":"alloy","format":"wav"}. Empty / invalid JSON → omitted. Example: {"voice":"alloy","format":"wav"}.

configurationParameters.label: Parallel Tool Calls
configurationParameters.description: Allow multiple tool calls in one assistant turn (parallel_tool_calls). Purpose: forwarded as a real boolean. Accepted values: boolean or true|1|yes|on / false|0|no|off. Unparseable → omitted. Default stored value 'false'. Example: true when the graph's tools are independent.

configurationParameters.label: Prompt Cache Key
configurationParameters.description: Stable string key for prompt-prefix caching on providers that support it. Purpose: bucket cache entries across calls that share a long system prompt. Accepted values: non-empty string. Empty → omitted. Not a secret; do not put PHI uniquely identifying a patient if your policy forbids it. Example: 'order-agent-sys-v3'.

configurationParameters.label: Seed
configurationParameters.description: Best-effort determinism seed forwarded as integer. Purpose: reproduce a sample when the engine honors seed. Accepted values: integers. Empty/non-numeric → omitted. Not a guarantee on all local engines. Example: 42.

configurationParameters.label: Stream
configurationParameters.description: Purpose: controls whether this provider requests a streamed completion and fans live deltas through helper emitPartial. Canonical flag. When true the node POSTs stream:true, parses SSE data: lines, emitPartial("thinking", delta) for reasoning/thinking and emitPartial("answer", delta) for content; thoughts also appear on llm_output.result.thoughts / thinking; finish_reason, usage and tool_calls are assembled at the end. Accepted: select true | false. Input-port stream/streaming overrides this config. Default: true. Invalid/blank → true. Example: true.
